tool_args.rationale: The earlier execution failed because the fitting rows lacked a y key. The supplied specification says labeled train_rows contain y, so this implementation validates that requirement and numerically fits positive Kelvin–Voigt parameters using the five available observations; their H variation and u_now scaling support this two-parameter law without another probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five rows across varying H constrain the two Kelvin–Voigt parameters; the feature pattern shows proportionality to u_now and no evident x_now effect.
It is unrelated to resolving the target law and explicitly should not be purchased.
Its prediction depends on x_now, whereas the observed outputs track u_now across strongly varying x_now.
It predicts a present-snapshot response based on u_now alone and does not naturally explain the observed near-proportional scaling with u_now and H.
